item.title: Musk bankers looking to trim xAI debt after SpaceX merger: report
item.description: xAI has built up $18 billion in debt over the past few years, with some of this being attributed to the purchase of social media platform Twitter (now X) and the creation of the AI development company. A new financing deal would help trim some of the financial burden that is currently present ahead of the plan to take SpaceX public sometime this year. The post Musk bankers looking to trim xAI debt after SpaceX merger: report appeared first on TESLARATI.

item.title: Tesla ends Full Self-Driving purchase option in the U.S.
item.description: In January, Musk announced that Tesla would remove the ability to purchase the suite outright for $8,000. This would give the vehicle Full Self-Driving for its entire lifespan, but Tesla intended to move away from it, for several reasons, one being that a tranche in the CEO's pay package requires 10 million active subscriptions of FSD.
